scientific_integrity: Exact finite-chain rates, non-Gaussian critical diffusion, and directional passage-time limits are proved under explicit assumptions; numerical tests are corroborative, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete graph, homogeneous fixed integer q>=2, positive zealots of both kinds, two fixed finite critical parameters, no spectral-gap theorem, no general topology claim; no exhaustive historical priority claim.
title: Joint critical-field diffusion and passage-time laws for nonlinear voter dynamics with zealots
